jobs.description: Post vacancies and follow candidates from shortlist to joining.
jobs.empty_body: Post your first vacancy. KaamSathi ops will shortlist verified workers, usually within 48 hours.

actions.publish_body: Once published, KaamSathi ops start matching and shortlisting verified workers for it.
actions.close_body: No new candidates will be shortlisted. Candidates already in the pipeline stay where they are.
actions.delete_body: The draft will be removed permanently. This cannot be undone.

form.create_description: Describe the role. Save it as a draft, or publish now so we can start shortlisting.
form.accommodation_hint: Room or quarters for the worker
form.created_not_published: Job saved as a draft, but publishing failed. Try publishing again.

detail.publish_hint: Use Publish at the top of the page.

move.title: Move {name}

move.interview_required: Pick an interview date and time
move.rejection_placeholder: e.g. Not enough experience for this kitchen
move.note_placeholder: Only your team can see this
